thread.title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Goes Against Its Principles By Leaking 3 New Massive iPhones

author: Brendan Byrne
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Goes Against Its Principles By Leaking 3 New Massive iPhones
text:
0 SHARE 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is one of the most vibrant companies around the globe and people who follow in at a close range understand that it doesn’t like the idea of anyone knowing about its iPhone plans. The company has been under immense pressure to perform better. This time around it is deemed that Apple might be more welcoming of the distraction that will be come along with the leak about its three latest 2018 iPhones. 
It is a matter that is stemming up from TrendForce which happens to be a respected technology analyst. 
A person familiar with the matter opined , “TrendForce states this year Apple will not only expand the next generation iPhone X into two model range with the arrival of an iPhone X Plus, but also finally update the iPhone SE after a two year hiatus. And the biggest change – as Nikkei has already revealed – is literally size.” 
The unveiling of iPhone X according to reports witnessed Apple move higher to a 5.8-inch panel for the first time. According to Nikkei, the iPhone X Plus might lead to a jump of 6.2 or 6.3-inches and most probably there might be the supersizing of iPhone SE from 4-inches to 6.1-inches.If you are the kind with small hands then this time around you might be compelled to look away. 
TrendForce has been pretty silent over the unveiling of the iPhone SE2.It hasn’t been a similar case with the iPhone X and iPhone X Plus since it has been vocal on the matter outlining that the gadgets will be employing the second generation of Face ID technology. 
What do we end up with as a result? Users might be witnessing increased screen-to-body ratios not forgetting the huge top memory configuration. A number of market analysts have made projections outlining that meanwhile Apple might need to consider looking away from TrendForce’s second section. The analyst outlines that indeed Apple might not end up reaping quite a huge deal from the sales ‘supercycle’ of 2018 even with its iPhone X. However, the company might be enjoying a rather modest sales growth. TAGS
